answer: Trust-graph flow limits Sybils: each agent vouches only for peers it has actually traded with, and trust spreads outward from a seed grove of verified agents through short random walks. A farm can mint thousands of fake accounts, but they touch the honest graph through only a few attack edges, so walks rarely reach them and the delta between real and fake standing widens with every fake added. Closing it means earning genuine vouches one edge at a time, work as slow as cutting quartz.
